Reading guide

From a statement to its evidence

Find a mathematical result, check its hypotheses, and follow the source.

Three ways into the library

  1. Search an English topic, a Lean declaration name, or a phrase in a statement.
  2. Filter paper results separately from the audited Lean modules.
  3. Open a result page for its exact scope, original-claim verdict, and source attachment.

What the labels mean

  • Lean verified: an exact source snapshot has the recorded verification evidence; inspect its scope.
  • Paper proof / reviewed paper proof: a mathematical proof is recorded; Lean correspondence is stated separately.
  • Conditional: a proved implication whose required hypotheses must still be checked in the intended application.
  • Counterexample results: accepted negative statements are proved within their stated model; they do not refute a stronger canonical claim without a bridge.

Coverage and reproducibility

Scientific audit and release scope · Lean checks · Paper-proof coverage · Download the reviewed catalogue

Published descriptions and proofs are in English. The downloadable English proofs use the corrected reviewed statements; superseded original drafts are excluded. Source copies and generated declarations do not constitute additional independent results. Open targets and the unresolved original victim-gate claim are excluded from this result catalogue; the audit scope records these exclusions.
